# Precision Home Services LLC

> Licensed home remodeling and repair contractor in Pasadena, Maryland (Anne Arundel County). Kitchens, bathrooms, club basements, tile, drywall and painting, doors, windows and trim (including historic C.H.A.P. projects), built-ins, stairs, railings and decks, rental turnovers and property maintenance. Free, no-pressure estimates.

## Licence
- Maryland Home Improvement Commission licence: MHIC #161406
- Licensed and insured in Maryland
- Check it: https://www.dllr.state.md.us/cgi-bin/ElectronicLicensing/OP_search/OP_search.cgi?calling_app=HIC::HIC_qselect

## Service area
Pasadena, Anne Arundel County, Baltimore, Frederick, Ocean City, Washington, D.C. and across Maryland.

## Services
- Kitchen remodels: cabinets, counters, backsplash, flooring, lighting
- Bathroom remodels: showers, tubs, vanities, tile
- Club basements (finished basements)
- Full-home renovations
- Drywall repair and installation
- Interior and exterior painting
- Carpet, laminate and tile, custom tile showers and backsplashes
- Doors, windows and trim, including projects with historical oversight (C.H.A.P., Baltimore City's Commission for Historical and Architectural Preservation)
- Framing, built-ins, media walls, accent walls and finish carpentry
- Stairs, railings and custom decks
- Rental turnovers and property management: ongoing maintenance, turnovers and upkeep for rentals and owners
- Repairs and handyman: drywall, paint, flooring, doors, fixtures, the punch list

## Who they work for
Homeowners, landlords and property managers, and owners of historic homes.

## How it works
1. Tell them the project. Estimates are free, with no pressure, and they reply within one business day.
2. Get a clear quote. Clear communication from quote to cleanup.
3. They build it and clean up. Workmanship guarantee on every project.
